description:
الرؤية المستقبلية لمشروع نوفا إنترا هي تطوير نظام دعم زراعي متكامل يربط المعلومات المستخلصة من الأقمار الصناعية، والذكاء الاصطناعي، والمعرفة الزراعية المحلية، والهندسة القائمة على الطاقة المتجددة.

تسعى نوفا إنترا إلى تحويل بيانات مراقبة الأرض إلى قرارات زراعية عملية، مع دعم الاستخدام المستدام للمياه الجوفية والطاقة المتجددة.

رؤيتنا بسيطة: زراعة أكثر ذكاء، مياه مستدامة.
summary:
	Future vision
	The future vision of the Nova intra project is to develop an integrated agriculture support system, linking satellite-derived information, artificial intelligence, local agricultural knowledge, and renewable energy-based engineering.
	Nova intra seeks to transform Earth observation data into practical agricultural decisions, while supporting the sustainable use of groundwater and renewable energy.
	Our vision is simple: smarter agriculture, sustainable water, and renewable energy for a climate-resilient future.
1-	Project overview
•	Nova intra is an integrated concept of engineering and digital innovation, aimed at supporting climate-resilient agriculture, sustainable water management, and improving agricultural decision-making in arid and semi-arid regions.
•	the project combines an intelligent agricultural Decision Support Platform powered by artificial intelligence, and a proposed system for pumping groundwater using hybrid renewable energy.
•	the digital platform will integrate NASA Earth Observation Data, local soil information, crop characteristics and farmers ' priorities, with the aim of analyzing agricultural conditions and studying sustainable crop rotation and irrigation strategies.
•	the engineering side proposes a hybrid system that combines wind energy, photovoltaic solar cells integrated into the turbine blades, an auxiliary mechanism for electromagnetic torque, and a mechanical system for pumping groundwater.
